SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT ORD_SHEET_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PMOK_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PMOK_CODE AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM RTMRO02 WHERE ORD_FLAG = '1'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KUKD' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(A.STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, A.ORD_SHEET_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(A.PMOK_SEQ,'FM000') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(A.PMOK_CODE,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(A.BASE_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(A.ORD_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(A.ORD_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(A.ORD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(A.INPUT_ORD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(A.ASK_PLACE_CODE,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(A.ORD_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(A.BUDGET_DEPT,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(A.ASK_ID,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(A.ASK_DEPT,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(A.BIGO,' ') AS REMARK, 'N' AS DOC_TYPE, ' ' AS REMARK2 FROM RTMRO02 A WHERE A.ORD_FLAG = '1' AND ORD_SHEET_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND PMOK_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND PMOK_CODE = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' ORDER BY A.ORD_SHEET_NO, A.PMOK_SEQ
UPDATE RTMRO02 SET ORD_FLAG = '2' WHERE ORD_FLAG = '1' AND ORD_SHEET_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND PMOK_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND PMOK_CODE = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$'
